idx.cal.title: The Khmer ចន្ទគតិ system
idx.cal.lead: For over a millennium, Cambodia has used a sophisticated lunisolar calendar that harmonizes the rhythms of the moon and sun — guiding everything from rice planting to sacred ceremonies.
idx.cal.p1: The Khmer lunar calendar, known as ចន្ទគតិ (Chântôkôtĕ), represents centuries of astronomical observation and mathematical refinement by Cambodian scholars and monks.
idx.cal.p2: This lunisolar system synchronizes two cycles: the lunar month (29–30 days) based on moon phases, and the solar year (~365.25 days) tracking Earth's orbit.
idx.cal.why: Traditional Cambodian life revolves around this calendar — determining planting seasons and celebrating បុណ្យភ្ជុំបិណ្ឌ (Pchum Ben), បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំខ្មែរ (Khmer New Year), and countless cultural events.
idx.cal.be.title: Buddhist Era years
idx.cal.be.desc: Counted from the parinirvana of Buddha (543 BCE) — 2025 CE equals BE 2568/2569. The transition occurs on Visakha Bochea, not January 1st.
idx.cal.leap.title: Leap months (Adhikameas)
idx.cal.leap.desc: To keep lunar and solar years aligned, a 13th month is added roughly every 2–3 years, preventing seasonal drift.
idx.cal.zodiac.title: Zodiac animal cycle
idx.cal.zodiac.desc: Each year maps to one of 12 animals — rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, goat, monkey, rooster, dog, pig.
idx.cal.moon.title: Moon phases
idx.cal.moon.desc: Each month splits into កើត (waxing, days 1–15) and រោច (waning, days 1–14/15).

doc.install.p2: The only runtime dependency is nesbot/carbon, so the package works in any PHP project — Laravel is optional. Inside a Laravel application it automatically registers its service provider, so no additional configuration is needed.

doc.basic.important.label: Important
doc.basic.important.p: Always use CarbonImmutable (not Carbon) and set the timezone to 'Asia/Phnom_Penh'.
doc.pure.p1: Laravel is not required. Instantiate Chhankitek directly and read the lunar date from the formatKhmerDate property:
doc.pure.p2: The toLunarDate() helper is also available outside Laravel:
doc.pure.note: Without a Laravel application, conversions automatically use a framework-free in-memory cache. See Caching to plug in your own cache store.
doc.methods.intro: The KhmerLunarDate object provides the following methods:
doc.methods.dayOfWeek.desc: Returns the Khmer day of the week.
doc.methods.lunarDay.desc: Returns the lunar day with moon status (កើត waxing, រោច waning).
doc.methods.lunarMonth.desc: Returns the Khmer lunar month name.
doc.methods.lunarYear.desc: Returns the Buddhist Era year in Khmer numerals.
doc.methods.toString.desc: Returns the complete lunar date as a formatted string.
doc.caching.p1: Converted dates are cached for 365 days to minimize computational overhead. The cache is swappable via the CacheRepository interface, so it works the same with or without Laravel:
doc.caching.li1: Inside Laravel — automatically uses Laravel's cache system (LaravelCache), respecting your configured driver (Redis, Memcached, file, etc.). No setup required.
doc.caching.li2: Pure PHP — falls back to an in-memory cache (ArrayCache) that de-duplicates lookups within a single request or script run.
doc.caching.own.p: Pass any implementation of Asorasoft\Chhankitek\Cache\CacheRepository as the second constructor argument:
doc.req.laravel: ^10.0 | ^11.0 | ^12.0 | ^13.0 (optional) — enables the facade, service provider, and persistent cache

doc.understand.months.p: The Khmer lunar calendar has 12 standard months. In leap years, an additional month (បឋមាសាឍ) is added:
doc.understand.days.p: Each lunar month is divided into two phases:
doc.understand.leap.p: The Khmer calendar has two types of leap years:
doc.understand.leap.li1: Leap Month Year (Adhikameas): An extra 13th month (បឋមាសាឍ) is added, making the year 384 days long.
doc.understand.leap.li2: Leap Day Year: An extra day is added to the month of ជេស្ឋ, making the year 355 days long.
doc.understand.leap.li3: Regular Year: 354 days with 12 months.
doc.understand.learn: Learn more: Visit Khmer Calendar for detailed information about the system.
doc.api.class.p: Framework-free entry point. The resulting lunar date is on the formatKhmerDate property. The optional CacheRepository defaults to Laravel's cache when an application is bound, otherwise an in-memory cache.
doc.api.trait.p: Converts a Gregorian date to Khmer lunar date format.
doc.api.helper.p: Global helper function for date conversion.
